newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish public sector budget deficit falls in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Danish public sector budget deficit falls in 1996.

text.p: Denmark's public sector budget deficit narrowed in 1996 to 14.5 billion crowns from the previous year's 18.7 billion crown shortfall, the national statistics office said on Thursday.
The deficit was lower than the economy ministry's latest estimate in May of a 16.2 billion crown deficit for last year and was attributed by the statistics office to a major rise in tax revenues.
The Danish economy ministry forecast in May that the public sector budget would swing into a 7.0 billion crown surplus in 1997, rising to 8.0 billion crowns next year.
